name: Peachy Hash & Co. | 200mg Live Rosin Gummies | Pineapple Orange
description: Not familiar with vape pens or dabbing quite yet, but want to experience the impeccable quality only solventless methods afford? Reach for Peachy Hash & Co’s Award-winning lineup of solventless rosin infused gummies. The same single-source cannabis resins refined in an ice water bath and pressed to golden-perfection, provide the fuel for our solventless gummies to fire. A dab a bite, some might say…
